source.title: Maricopa County Elections — early returns in hand
source.notes: Sum of the official layer’s 944 non-null general-election precinct records. 12 layer records have no election label/counts and are excluded, not treated as zero. Returns include all signature-review dispositions; they are not accepted ballots or candidate votes.

metrics.label: Ballots requested (source Requests)
metrics.definition: Official aggregate Requests field; requests are distinct from ballots mailed, issued, received or accepted.
metrics.coverage_note: 944 general-election records; 12 null/unattributed layer records excluded. Partial source coverage.

metrics.label: Early voting returns in hand
metrics.definition: Official aggregate Returns field: all early voting returns in hand, regardless of disposition in signature review. Not an accepted-ballot count.
metrics.coverage_note: 944 general-election records; 12 null/unattributed layer records excluded. Partial source coverage.
